title: HealthForm
guideIntro: You're testing a medical registration portal. Fill out the registration, check the history form, and review the confirmation page.

bugs.title: Phone field missing label
bugs.description: The phone number input uses placeholder text as its only label. Screen readers cannot identify the field's purpose.
bugs.remediation: Add <label for="phone">Phone number</label> before the input.
bugs.guideHint: Tab through the form — does every field announce itself?

bugs.title: Positive tabindex disrupts tab order
bugs.description: The phone field has tabindex="5", which forces it to receive focus before other fields, breaking the expected top-to-bottom navigation.
bugs.remediation: Remove the tabindex attribute or set it to 0.
bugs.guideHint: Press Tab repeatedly — does the focus order make sense?

bugs.title: Required field has no indicator
bugs.description: The allergies field is clinically required but has no asterisk, no aria-required, and no visual distinction from optional fields.
bugs.remediation: Add aria-required="true" and a visual asterisk (*).
bugs.guideHint: Look for form fields that should be required but aren't

bugs.title: Error message has insufficient contrast
bugs.description: The error message text (#f87171) on the light gray background (#f3f4f6) has a contrast ratio of 3.1:1, below the 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimum.
bugs.remediation: Use a darker red like #dc2626 for the error text.
bugs.guideHint: Squint at the text colors — can you read everything easily?

bugs.title: Blood type radio buttons overlap
bugs.description: The radio button group uses absolute positioning that causes the O+ and O- labels to overlap each other.
bugs.remediation: Use flexbox or grid layout instead of absolute positioning.
bugs.guideHint: Watch for elements sitting on top of each other

bugs.title: Edit link goes nowhere
bugs.description: The 'Edit your information' link has href="#" and does not navigate back to the registration form.
bugs.remediation: Set href to "register.html" to link back to the form.
bugs.guideHint: Click every link — do they all go somewhere?

bugs.title: Heading level skips from h1 to h4
bugs.description: The page jumps from <h1> to <h4>, skipping h2 and h3. This confuses screen reader users who navigate by heading level.
bugs.remediation: Use <h2> for section headings under the page title.
bugs.guideHint: Check the heading structure — does it flow logically?
